full_text_zh:
[P1] 远交近攻

[P2] 战国的时候，有一个魏国人，名叫范雎。他在魏国中大夫须贾的府上当门客，才能突出，却引起了须贾的嫉妒。

[P3] 有一次，范雎跟着须贾一起
出使齐国。齐王看范雎口才
好，人也聪明，就送给他十
斤黄金和许多牛肉、美酒。

须贾看见了，又嫉妒又生气："哼，为
什么齐王只给范雎送礼，不给我送？
一定是范雎把魏国的秘密卖给了齐
王！"回到魏国后，须贾就把这件事
报告给了相国。

[P4] 相国大怒，叫人重重地惩罚范雎。"啪！啪！"木杖一声声打在范雎的身上，他"啊呀"一声，疼晕了过去。相国又命人用草席卷了卷，把他扔进了大牢。

[P5] "唉，真可怜呀！"看守很同情范雎。范雎醒来后，拉着看守的衣服苦苦哀求道："您如果能放我走，我日后必定重重地谢您。"

[P6] 看守也想救范雎一命，就去请示相国："大人，那个卷在席子里的人已经死了，把他扔掉吧！"
相国在宴席上喝醉了酒，随便挥了挥手说："扔了吧！"
范雎的朋友就趁机悄悄接走了受伤的范雎，把他藏了起来。

[P7] 须贾听说范雎被扔出去了，
却不相信他死了，便派人
到处搜捕他。
这可怎么办？

[P8] 范雎让妻子在家挂起白布、白灯笼，
为他举行了葬礼。须贾一见，这才
相信范雎死了，停止了搜捕。
正巧这时秦昭王派使臣来到魏国，
寻访有才能的人。范雎就跟着使臣，
一起去了秦国。

[P9] “胡说八道，这些人只会耍嘴皮子吓唬人。”秦昭王不悦地说，“我秦国，向南打败了楚国，向东攻破过齐国，邻近的韩、赵、魏三国都不是我们的对手。秦国如此强大，怎么会有危险呢！

到了秦国，使臣向秦王禀报说：‘大王，我从魏国给您带回来一个厉害的人！他说，咱们秦国现在非常危险，就像堆起来的蛋一样，轻轻一推就会打碎，只有采用他的方法，才能转危为安！’

[P10] 秦昭王不愿意见范雎。没有办法，使臣只好安排范雎住进了又低又矮的客房，每天吃的都是粗糙又简单的食物。就这样，范雎在秦国住了一年多。

[P11] 这一年，秦王要穿过韩国和魏国，去攻打齐国。范雎听说后赶紧给秦昭王写了一封信：‘我听说，高明的医生知道病人的生死，圣明的君主知道怎么做对国家最好。对国家好的方法就要实行，对国家有害的方法就要舍弃。此次出征到底对秦国有没有利，我不敢写在信上，请让我拜见您面谈。’

[P12] 大军临行前，秦昭王又看了看范雎的信，犹豫再三，还是决定见一见范雎。于是，他派人去请范雎。范雎行礼后忧心地说："大王，跳过韩国和魏国，去攻打齐国，大错特错呀！"秦昭王疑惑地说："七国中，我秦国是第一强国，第二就是齐国。秦国要称霸天下，必须先攻下齐国，这有什么错呢？"

[P13] 只听范雎说："攻打齐国，出兵少了打不赢，出兵多了，又怕其他国家趁机偷袭。而且，齐国离秦国那么远，就算打胜了，咱也占领不了齐国的土地，只会让韩、魏那两个邻国捡便宜。韩、魏强大了，又会反过来攻打秦国，这不是送兵器给强盗，送粮食给小偷吗？"秦昭王想了想，觉得范雎说的有道理。可是，不打齐国，秦国怎么能称霸天下呢？

[P14] "大王不如跟远方的齐国和楚国交好，攻打近处的赵、韩、魏三国。这样一来，大王打下一寸土地，就能掌管一寸土地；打下一尺土地，就能掌管一尺土地。"
"远交近攻，真是妙计呀！"秦昭王听了范雎的话，非常佩服，马上任命他为客卿。

[P15] 秦昭王打开国库，让范雎带着金银财宝出使齐国和楚国，与他们结盟；又派出强大的秦军，打得魏国俯首称臣，打得韩国节节败退，打得赵国没有了还手之力。
最后，秦国越来越强大，消灭了其他诸侯国，统一了六国。

[P16] 秦昭王用范雎的计策，远交齐国和楚国，近攻魏国、韩国、赵国，不让这些诸侯国结成联盟，然后一个一个地攻破，终于称霸天下。这样的计策，就叫“远交近攻”。
full_text_en:
[P1] Make friends with distant states and attack nearby ones.

[P2] During the Warring States period, there was a man from the State of Wei named Fan Ju. He served as a guest in the household of the chief minister Xu Jia, where his talents stood out, but this aroused Xu Jia's jealousy.

[P3] Once, Fan Ju accompanied Xu Jia on a diplomatic mission to the State of Qi. The King of Qi, impressed by Fan Ju's eloquence and intelligence, gave him ten jin of gold, as well as much beef and fine wine.

Xu Jia saw this and became both jealous and angry: "Hmph, why did the King of Qi give gifts to Fan Ju but not to me? It must be that Fan Ju has sold Hui State's secrets to the King of Qi!" After returning to the State of Wei, Xu Jia reported this matter to the Prime Minister.

[P4] The prime minister was furious and ordered his men to severely punish Fan Ju. "Thwack! Thwack!" The wooden rods struck Fan Ju repeatedly. He cried out, "Ah!" and fainted from the pain. The prime minister then ordered his men to roll him up in a straw mat and throw him into prison.

[P5] "Ah, how pitiful!" The guard felt great sympathy for Fan Ju. After waking up, Fan Ju clutched the guard's clothes and pleaded desperately: "If you could let me go, I will surely repay you greatly in the future."

[P6] The guard, wanting to save Fan Ju's life, went to ask the prime minister: "Sir, the man rolled up in the mat is already dead. Please throw him away!"
Drunk at the banquet, the prime minister waved his hand carelessly and said: "Throw him away!"
Fan Ju's friend then secretly took away the injured Fan Ju and hid him.

[P7] Xu Jia heard that Fan Ju had been thrown out,
but he didn't believe he was dead, so he sent people
to search for him everywhere.
What should be done now?

[P8] Fan Ju let his wife hang white cloth and white lanterns at home,
holding a funeral for him. When Xu Jia saw this, he finally
believed Fan Ju was dead and stopped the search.
Just then, King Zhao of Qin sent an envoy to Wei,
seeking talented people. Fan Ju followed the envoy,
and together they went to Qin.

[P9] "Nonsense, these people only use their tongues to scare others," King Zhao of Qin said displeasedly. "My Qin state has defeated Chu to the south, broken through Qi to the east, and the neighboring states of Han, Zhao, and Wei are no match for us. With Qin so powerful, how could there be any danger?"

Upon arriving in Qin, the envoy reported to the king: "Your Majesty, I have brought back a remarkable man from Wei! He says our Qin state is now in great danger, like a pile of eggs that would shatter with just a light push. Only by adopting his method can we turn danger into safety!"

[P10] King Zhao of Qin was unwilling to meet Fan Ju. With no other choice, the envoy had to arrange for Fan Ju to stay in a low and cramped guest room, where he ate only coarse and simple food every day. In this way, Fan Ju lived in Qin for over a year.

[P11] This year, the King of Qin planned to pass through the states of Han and Wei to attack Qi. Upon hearing this, Fan Ju hurriedly wrote a letter to King Zhao of Qin: 'I have heard that a skilled doctor knows whether a patient will live or die, and a wise ruler knows what is best for the state. Methods that benefit the state should be implemented, while those that harm it should be discarded. Whether this campaign will benefit Qin or not, I dare not write it in this letter. I beg to meet Your Majesty in person to discuss it.'

[P12] Before the army set out, King Zhao of Qin looked again at Fan Ju's letter, hesitated for a while, and finally decided to meet Fan Ju. He then sent someone to invite Fan Ju. After bowing, Fan Ju said anxiously, "Your Majesty, skipping over Korea and Wei to attack Qi is a great mistake!" King Zhao replied doubtfully, "Among the Seven States, Qin is the strongest, and Qi is the second. For Qin to dominate the world, we must first conquer Qi. What's wrong with that?"

[P13] Fan Ju said: "Attacking Qi, if we send too few troops, we won't win; if we send too many, other countries might take advantage and attack us. Moreover, Qi is so far from Qin. Even if we win, we won't be able to hold its land, and it will only benefit our neighbors, Han and Wei. If Han and Wei grow stronger, they will turn around and attack Qin. Isn't this like giving weapons to bandits and food to thieves?" King Zhao of Qin thought about it and found Fan Ju's reasoning sound. But still, if Qin doesn't attack Qi, how can it become the dominant power under heaven?

[P14] "Your Majesty, it would be better to be friendly with distant states like Qi and Chu, and attack nearby states such as Zhao, Han, and Wei. This way, for every inch of land you conquer, you will control an inch; for every foot of land you conquer, you will control a foot."
"The strategy of befriending distant states and attacking nearby ones—what a brilliant plan!" King Zhao of Qin, after hearing Fan Ju's advice, was deeply impressed and immediately appointed him as a guest minister.

[P15] King Zhao of Qin opened the national treasury, sent Fan Ju with gold and silver treasures to visit Qi and Chu, and formed alliances with them; he also sent powerful Qin troops, defeating Wei to make it submit, pushing Korea back step by step, and leaving Zhao without any ability to fight back.
Finally, Qin became increasingly powerful, eliminated other feudal states, and unified the Six Kingdoms.

[P16] King Zhao of Qin adopted Fan Ju's strategy: making friends with distant states like Qi and Chu, while attacking nearby states such as Wei, Han, and Zhao. This prevented the feudal states from forming alliances, allowing Qin to conquer them one by one and eventually dominate the realm. This strategy was called 'befriend the distant, attack the nearby'.
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页标题为“远交近攻”，配图是一位古代人物骑在马上，画面简洁，突出主题。
[P2] 本页介绍了战国时期魏国人范雎在须贾府中做门客，因才能出众而引起须贾嫉妒的背景。
[P3] 本页讲述了范雎随须贾出使齐国时，因才华出众获得齐王赏赐，引发须贾嫉妒，回国后向相国诬告范雎出卖国家机密。
[P4] 本页描绘了范雎因被诬告而遭到相国重罚，被木杖毒打至晕厥，随后被草席卷起扔进大牢的场景。
[P5] 范雎在牢中被看守发现，看守同情他，范雎醒来后向看守苦苦哀求放他离开，并承诺日后重谢。
[P6] 范雎被诬告后遭重罚，被卷入席中扔进大牢。看守向醉酒的相国请示，称范雎已死，相国同意将其扔掉。范雎的朋友趁机将他救走并藏了起来。
[P7] 须贾得知范雎被扔出后仍不信其死，派人四处搜捕，范雎处境危急。
[P8] 范雎的妻子为他举行葬礼，须贾见状信以为真，停止搜捕。恰逢秦昭王派使臣到魏国寻访人才，范雎便随使臣前往秦国。
[P9] 使臣向秦昭王禀报范雎的计策，称秦国处境危险，需采纳其方法才能转危为安，但秦昭王对此表示怀疑，认为秦国强大无虞。
[P10] 范雎初到秦国时，因秦昭王不愿接见，被使臣安排在简陋的客房中，过着清苦的生活，一住就是一年多。
[P11] 范雎得知秦王将攻打齐国，便写信给秦昭王，请求面谈出征利弊，强调应以国家利益为重，不可轻率行事。
[P12] 秦昭王在出征前收到范雎的信，犹豫后决定召见他。范雎劝阻攻打齐国，认为应先攻韩魏，秦昭王则质疑其观点，认为秦国应先攻最强的齐国以称霸天下。
[P13] 范雎向秦昭王分析攻打齐国的弊端，指出此举可能让韩魏得利并反攻秦国，秦昭王虽认同其理，但仍犹豫是否放弃攻打齐国以称霸天下。
[P14] 范雎向秦昭王提出‘远交近攻’的策略，秦昭王听后大为赞赏，当即任命他为客卿。
[P15] 秦昭王采纳范雎的策略，派他出使齐楚并派兵攻打魏、韩、赵，使秦国日益强盛，最终统一六国。
[P16] 本页说明秦昭王采纳范雎的‘远交近攻’策略，通过联合远方国家、攻打邻近国家，逐步瓦解敌对联盟，最终实现称霸天下。
